reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to generate presentation documents: a DSH agent tool turns structured slide data into a self-contained HTML deck, with optional PPTX export, fixed themes, and speaker-notes support. It is best classified as document-processing because its core value is formatting and exporting presentation content for speakers and collaborators, while also interacting with the host filesystem and media/image assets as documented.

summaries.zh: dsh-slides 是 DeepSeek Harness 的插件工具，可将结构化的演讲大纲生成可离线播放的 HTML 幻灯片，并可同步输出可编辑的 PPTX 文件。
summaries.en: dsh-slides is a DeepSeek Harness plugin tool that converts structured talk outlines into self-contained HTML slide decks and can also export an editable PPTX version.

capabilities: Generate slide decks from structured data as offline HTML output
Optionally export a second editable PPTX artifact from the same deck
Persist outputs to workspace filesystem via configured output directory
Handle speaker notes separately from slide content
Apply predefined visual themes to generated slides

reasons.code: `make_slides` is presented as a single tool that writes a talk to one HTML file and optionally a PPTX when `formats` includes both `html` and `pptx`, with defined slide layouts and notes handling.
The plugin is packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin via `dsh` bundle metadata (`cordis.patch.yml`) in `package.json`, indicating integration into an agent workflow.
Images are described as either `data:` URIs (embedded) or `https` URLs, and the presentation is described as offline/self-contained when using the embedded form, confirming media-in-deck handling.
The repository includes source/tests/build setup and publishes as the `dsh-slides` package, aligning with an executable plugin artifact rather than a static doc-only repository.
